reasoning: This is a standalone web application (service) consisting of a Go backend-for-frontend (BFF) server and a React + PatternFly 6 frontend. The Go BFF exposes REST API endpoints via chi router on port 8080, proxying requests to the OpenShell gateway's gRPC API. The React frontend is a full admin UI for managing OpenShell workspaces, sandboxes, providers, and policies. It is deployed as a container image (Dockerfile in deploy/) combining the compiled Go server with static frontend assets. While the frontend is also published as an npm package for downstream embedding, the primary deployment unit is a running HTTP service — not an operator (no CRDs, no reconciliation loops, no controller-runtime), not a library (it runs as a server process), and not pure configuration.
